canonical_project: PAFEN national physical data hosting solution (data center)
owner: Government of Burundi / SETIC / World Bank (IDA)
notes: World Bank PAFEN (IDA USD 92M) project documents include preparation of specifications for a new physical data hosting solution (a data center); finance ministry 2026-03-23 mid-term review names a national data center as priority; SETIC/PAFEN AMI for data-hosting study (2024) shows procurement path. Exact site not public; assigned to Bujumbura Mairie (central government cluster). May overlap with CDIN (see de-dup note there).
